title: Logging: scheduling failure
caption: Scheduler events show unbound storage, insufficient CPU/memory and control-plane taints. Diagnostic evidence, not a resolved state.

title: Logging: pods running
caption: A later capture shows the listed logging pods Ready and Running after an ingester pod deletion. It does not prove log ingestion, retention or alert delivery.

title: Velero restore result
caption: manual-restore reports Completed, 0 errors and 1 warning. Application data integrity and the warning cause are not established by this capture.

title: MINDNAN product interface
caption: Historical public-facing homepage capture. Shows the interface and intended booking journey; does not verify payments, therapist credentials, bookings or current service health.

title: Cloud Run revision completed
caption: Service update, revision creation and traffic routing are marked Completed; the latest revision receives 100% traffic. Earlier failed revisions remain visible. This is deployment-state evidence, not end-to-end application testing.

title: Vercel frontend Ready
caption: Historical Vercel frontend deployment shows Ready and source revision a21bb7d. This is not a new deployment of this portfolio or evidence of current availability.

title: Azure VM deployment
caption: AmorVM is shown Running with Deployment succeeded. Account, subscription identifier, public IP and billing details are removed. This is a VM deployment, not proof of AKS or Terraform execution.

title: ESXi network topology
caption: Two port groups and one uplink are visible. The no-uplink-redundancy warning is preserved. This documents topology inspection, not high availability or a completed VPN migration.

title: Borg backup archive result
caption: Borg reports 81,286 files, 20.14 GB original, 10.45 GB compressed and 9.99 GB deduplicated for an archive. This shows archive creation; a successful restore has not been demonstrated.
